business_problem: Tianmai Juyuan needed to organize and search a massive broadcast-video archive quickly enough to support timely publishing, short-video creation and intelligent content retrieval.
solution_summary: Tianmai Juyuan used Baidu AI Cloud to transform a giant broadcast archive into a searchable, production-ready media asset platform. The foundation is Baidu's MCA media-content-analysis service, which applies multimodal recognition across video, speech, text, public figures, objects and scenes and then outputs structured tags. Those tags power Yunsou, Tianmai's cloud media-asset search tool, and make it possible to search live and archived content precisely across domestic mainstream media. Baidu also supported a production path beyond search: the micro-editing workflow can ingest live TV streams, automatically clip them, transcode them and publish short videos within minutes. From an architectural standpoint, object storage retains the large video corpus, speech recognition and content analysis extract searchable structure, and the clipping layer turns tagged assets into publishable short-form content. That gives Tianmai a combined archive, search and production stack rather than just a passive content repository.

solution_components.name: Media Content Analysis (MCA)
solution_components.role: Extracts structured tags from video, audio and visual content for search and editing.

solution_components.name: Real-Time Speech Recognition
solution_components.role: Converts spoken program content into searchable text within the media workflow.

solution_components.name: BOS Object Storage
solution_components.role: Stores the very large video archive used for search and clipping workflows.

solution_components.name: Micro-Editing Platform
solution_components.role: Ingests live streams, clips them automatically and publishes short-form video outputs.

data_flow: Broadcast video and live streams are stored in BOS, analyzed by MCA and speech-recognition services to generate structured tags, then surfaced in Yunsou search and fed into the micro-editing workflow for clipping, transcoding and distribution.
business_outcome: Tianmai Juyuan gained a combined search-and-production platform that speeds asset discovery, improves tagging quality and makes it much easier to turn live broadcast content into short video quickly.
metrics: The archive includes 500+ broadcast channels, more than 10 years of content, 20 million hours, 200 million clips and 6 PB of data.
MCA analysis efficiency improved 3-5x over manual tagging.
New TV programs can be turned into short videos and published within 3 minutes.
architecture_clues: The platform combines archive storage, search and short-video production on one stack
Multimodal tags include scenes, people, places, entities and keywords
Live-stream ingestion and clipping are built into the production path
